title: Atomus component
description: One component of the Atomus design system: a React export of @stanvision/atomus-react, or a Figma-only component set that has no React export. Generated by scripts/build-manifest.mjs.

name.description: React export name (Button) or, for Figma-only components, the Figma component set name (Drawer).

kind.description: component = renders UI; hook = a React hook (useToast).

status.description: stable = exported by @stanvision/atomus-react; figma-only = exists in the Figma file only (never import it in code); beta and deprecated are reserved.

since.description: Atomus version that introduced the component.

category.description: Catalogue group (Actions, Forms and inputs, Feedback …).

import.description: The import statement, or null for Figma-only components.

source.description: Repo path of the TypeScript source (React) or of the guideline file (Figma-only).

purpose.description: What to use the component for, in one sentence.

description.description: The Figma component description from the guidelines.

aliases.description: Other names people use for it (dialog → Modal). From guidelines/overview-components.md.

alternative.description: Figma-only components: what to use in code instead.

native.description: React components that spread native attributes: the element whose attributes they accept (button, input, a, element = any HTML element).

ref.description: true when ref is forwarded to the root element.

props.description: Props by name. For Figma-only components these are the Figma properties.

related.description: Names of related entries in the manifest.

element.description: Native element or ARIA role the component renders.

requiresLabel.description: true when the component needs a visible label or an aria-label.

type.description: TypeScript type (React) or Figma property type (text, boolean, variant, instance swap, slot).

values.description: Allowed literal values when the prop is an enum.

default.description: Default value as written in source (e.g. 'secondary'), or null.

figma.description: Figma property this prop mirrors (Hierarchy, Size, State=Loading …).

prop.description: React prop it maps to (children = the element's content).

kind.description: enum = value map; text = string copied; boolean = toggles a prop; flag = prop is true when the Figma enum has one value (State=Loading → loading); instance = nested instance; expression = custom logic (see notes).

when.description: kind=flag: the Figma value that turns the prop on.

visibleWhen.description: Boolean Figma property that must be on for the prop to render.

whenTrue.description: kind=boolean: JSX attribute rendered when the Figma boolean is on.

whenFalse.description: kind=boolean: JSX attribute rendered when the Figma boolean is off.

staticProps.description: Attributes the Code Connect template always renders (iconOnly …).

componentSet.description: Figma component set names this entry covers.

fileKey.description: Key of the original Atomus Figma file (sold separately). Projects use their own copy.

codeConnect.description: true when a Code Connect template maps the Figma component to this React component.

properties.description: Figma component properties from the guidelines.
